title: Commit-specific explanations
responsibility: Selects reasons that explain a commit’s own first-parent changes rather than merely belonging to a longer verification range.

inputs.name: revisionReasons.sources
inputs.description: First parent, optional own required changes, noted explanations and intact-record explanations with each record’s comparison base.

outputs.name: revisionReasons
outputs.description: Unique explanations in stable canonical order plus a count of held reasons belonging only to other changes/ranges. Exact-base record reasons are retained; known own changes are matched by fingerprints, otherwise notes not held solely by longer records are kept.
